content.title: Calmer Evenings
content.subtitle: A Workbook For Winding Down After Work
content.summary: A practical workbook that helps tired readers look at where their evenings go and build small habits that last.
content.targetAudience: Busy adults who finish work tired and want calmer evenings.
uniqueSellingPoints: a week of tracking per chapter
content.toneNotes: Warm and direct. One chapter a week, with a pen at hand.

introduction.outline: What the workbook asks and how to use it.

chapters.title: Where Your Evening Goes
chapters.promise: You will plan one calmer evening.
chapters.summary: How an evening drifts and how one small change, tied to a cue, holds it steady.
chapters.openingHookIdea: An evening that started well and drifted
storyIdeas: a composite reader who scrolls until midnight

exercises.title: Your Usual Evening
exercises.purpose: Notice what happens in the hour after work and how it leaves you feeling.

exercises.title: Before You Start Tonight
exercises.purpose: Get the pieces of one small change in place.

exercises.title: Seven Evenings
exercises.purpose: Record a week of the change to see what works.

chapters.title: Ending The Day Well
chapters.promise: You will plan one calmer evening.
chapters.summary: How an evening drifts and how one small change, tied to a cue, holds it steady.
chapters.openingHookIdea: An evening that started well and drifted
storyIdeas: a composite reader who scrolls until midnight

exercises.title: Sam's Late Finish
exercises.purpose: Practise planning around a bad day using a made-up example.

exercises.title: My Last Hour
exercises.purpose: Write a simple plan for the hour before bed.

content.backCoverBlurb: A workbook for people who finish work tired. Each chapter teaches one idea and gives you space to try it.
